top: The Empire State Building turned gold this week for Voyager 1, a spacecraft launched in 1977. It's now one full light-day from Earth: a message takes 24 hours to reach it.
comment: It has less memory than one photo on your phone and it's still texting home from 16 billion miles away 🤯
